test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddc80bf2e7df8a1d6ea2bcfb497578b8ce0d8efde8f3984c124a096a81767940.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The upper triangle rotates 90º in the clockwise direction, the middle triangle rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction and the lower triangle rotates 180º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92056cda4b0f56ab3d16e12a71ea8759a3bc9e036327ff6aa1e07a5116d0a46d.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The upper triangle rotates 90º in the clockwise direction, the middle triangle rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction and the lower triangle rotates 180º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d36b4d1b0d53c022e27b7efca93f9a0793a9e57183a215d6dc6b42ce906c23f.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The upper triangle rotates 90º in the clockwise direction, the middle triangle rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction and the lower triangle rotates 180º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eb97ec4ad4d878c0e7ce852f11d8d63314c4350258f53d4a0c10d929a5a9f88.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

The upper triangle rotates 90º in the clockwise direction, the middle triangle rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction and the lower triangle rotates 180º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d7c691e8bb7539e653dc5606d417cff1c604c67c6dcd83a196d153a9439e2b0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**
